name: Ira
text: I am very impressed with Mark's work. He was exceptionally punctual, which, in my experience, is quite rare among tradies. I have never seen a painter work so cleanly and keep everything spotless throughout the entire process. What stood out the most was his attitude towards his work, he genuinely cared about the outcome, ensuring everything was done to the highest standard, not just about completing the job. Highly recommend!

name: Peter Papa
text: I used Elite Master Painting for my home as we needed a paint refresh. Mark and his team were extremely professional and assisted me in choosing the right colour scheme for my place. Mark's painting skills are second to none and I would definitely use his services for all my future projects. Highly recommended.

name: Brenda Plant
text: Mark first completed a paint job in our bathroom following a renovation. We were so impressed we asked him to paint our outside window frames and doors. Mark and his team were amazing. They were punctual, clean, hard working and meticulous. I have already recommended him to a friend and would certainly employ him for future painting.
